We understand your complaint that your journey with Aurelia Skyways was disrupted, your companion animal was not handled with the expected care, and the response you received did not resolve the situation.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has reviewed the record and passed the matter to operations so the sequence of events can be checked against the ground handling report. Our team treats every carrier transfer as a shared responsibility, and when a passenger raises a concern we move quickly to confirm what happened, who handled the transfer, and whether the service steps were followed without delay. If any part of the process fell short, we will address it directly with the station team and the supervising staff.

<<FACT F119>> 
<<FACT F109>> 

If you are seeking reimbursement or follow-up on related expenses, include all supporting papers and send them through the usual claim channel without delay. The review team will match the documents to the flight file, verify the departure disruption, and confirm whether the standard payout applies to the incident. Where a companion animal is involved, we also check the care log, kennel handoff notes, and any service alert recorded by the ground crew so that no step is overlooked.

Please note that our first priority is the welfare of the animal and the clarity of the record. If there was a minor injury, the claim file must be opened within the permitted period, and any supporting note from a veterinary provider should be attached if available. We cannot finalize any action until the facts are verified, but we can confirm that this complaint has been escalated for urgent handling and that a supervisor has been asked to follow up.

We know that this kind of disruption can be stressful, especially when a traveler has done everything required before travel. That is not the level of service Aurelia Skyways expects, and we are taking the complaint seriously. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue to coordinate with the airport team until the review is complete and the outcome is recorded in the service file.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
